body:
**Downstream release request: steedos-labs/os-project-blackcat-crm**

The blackcat CRM pins `@objectstack/*` 18.4.0. Five of its blocked cards wait on fixes that are merged on `main` but were merged *after* the 18.4.0 tag (`181ad7d445`). The pending 18.5.0 in this Version Packages PR would carry all of them. The maintainer of that project asks for the 18.5.0 cut when convenient.

| Fix (merged after 18.4.0) | Platform card | Downstream card |
|---|---|---|
| `f054a0b3` (#33139) | #33111 drawer-level Edit opens the wrong form | blackcat #42 |
| `f054a0b3` (#33139) | #33112 drawer over a record page loses the child's related tabs | blackcat #45 |
| `69c77ad6` | #33107 lookup dimension shows raw ids | blackcat #47 |
| `09da8c7b` | #33213 duplicate refusal ignores locale | blackcat #51 (also needs #33214, still open) |
| `47a3b95e` | #33206 / #33207 seed organization context and `owner_id` by name | blackcat #55 |

I checked each fix with `git merge-base --is-ancestor <fix> 181ad7d445`: all exit 1, so none is in 18.4.0. `npm view @objectstack/spec dist-tags` shows `latest: 18.4.0`.

Per AGENTS rule 15 the release act is the maintainer's. This is a request only; no seat will merge this PR or publish.
